title: Rabbi Chalifi bar Zutrei
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Pesikta deRav Kahana 133b he speaks in Rabbi Yesa’s name. This statement is cited at the beginning of Vayikra Rabbah, chapter 16, in the name of Chilfi bar Idi; in Eichah Rabbah 4:18 it is attributed to Chalfi bar Zevid and to Rabbi Berekhyah in the name of Rabbi Issi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital Eichah Rabbah 4:18 jointly has Rabbi Berekhyah and Chalfi bar Zevid reporting Rabbi Issi. Hyman’s Chalifi bar Zutrei / Chilfi bar Idi / Chalfi bar Zevid forms remain distinct.

Buber’s printed Pesikta 133b has Rabbi Chalifi bar Zimri in Rabbi Yisa’s name. The consulted digital Pesikta 17:6 has Rabbi Berechyah and Chalfo bar Zavud in Rabbi Yisa’s name. The consulted Vayikra Rabbah passage has Rabbi Chiya and Chilfa bar Idi in Rabbi Yose’s name.
